text:
QUOTE: "the deny list is the only one that can stop a call after the approval step." / "`ServerManager::execute` ... This is the only place the deny list is consulted." / "The deny check in step 4 is then the only real stop."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer places the deny check in ServerManager::execute but also lists other blocking checks, such as hook cancellation, preconditions, and "Permission denied" at the approval step. It does not conclude that deny is the only list that blocks execution, and it adds that an allow-list miss with no callback denies the call.
